_note: 유형별 묶음 구조. 같은 23번 지문이라도 유형마다 passage(8문장)를 다르게 paraphrase 한다. order/insert/irrelevant/writing 은 구조상 예외.

passage: Trade is often held back not by a shortage of buyers or markets, but by the difficulty of delivering goods to those markets at competitive prices.
For firms, transaction costs are far from trivial: beyond the direct cost of exchange, there are the costs of converting, paying, and hedging money simply to settle for goods and services.
When several countries share a single currency, many of these transaction costs vanish.
The money once wasted on conversion can then be channeled back into a firm's productivity and innovation.
In effect, unproductive costs are transformed into productive investment, yielding long-term gains for the entire economy.
By uniting their currencies, economies tend to grow more than they ever could while standing alone.
A shared currency thus lays a firm economic foundation from which everyone can benefit.
The advantage is not confined to a single firm but spreads across whole economies.
choices: how a shared currency lowers costs and fuels broad economic growth
why fluctuating exchange rates protect small national economies
how cultural differences slow down international trade agreements
the reasons companies prefer cash payments over digital transfers
the historical origins of money in early trading societies
theme.explanation_ko: 공통 통화가 거래 비용을 없애고 그 절약분이 생산성·혁신에 재투자되어 경제 전체가 성장한다는 내용. '공통 통화가 비용을 낮추고 광범위한 경제 성장을 이끈다'가 주제이다.
theme.distractor_ko: ②환율 변동의 보호 효과, ③문화 차이, ④현금 선호, ⑤화폐의 기원은 본문에 없다.

passage: Many obstacles to trade arise less from missing customers than from the high cost of reaching markets at competitive prices.
Companies therefore should not underestimate transaction costs, which include converting, paying, and hedging funds on top of the plain cost of exchange.
Nations that can share a single currency ought to do so, because doing so removes a large share of these costs.
The money saved can be reinvested into productivity and innovation instead of being lost in conversion.
In this way, useless costs become productive ones, and the benefits reach the whole economy over the long term.
Economies that unify their currencies tend to grow faster together than they would apart.
Policymakers should thus view a common currency as a foundation for shared prosperity, not merely a convenience.
Refusing such cooperation means leaving real economic gains on the table.
choices: 각국은 자국 통화를 지켜 환율 주권을 유지해야 한다.
기업은 거래 비용을 줄이기 위해 결제를 미뤄야 한다.
공통 통화를 채택하여 비용을 절감하고 공동 번영을 추구해야 한다.
혁신보다 생산성 향상에 자원을 우선 배분해야 한다.
무역 장벽은 고객 부족 때문이므로 시장 확대에 집중해야 한다.
claim.explanation_ko: 공통 통화를 채택해 거래 비용을 없애고 절약분을 재투자하여 경제 전체가 함께 성장해야 한다는 주장. ③이 정답.
claim.distractor_ko: ①환율 주권, ②결제 지연, ④자원 배분 우선순위, ⑤고객 부족 원인은 핵심 주장이 아니다.

passage: The real barrier to trade is frequently the cost of getting goods to market competitively, not a lack of demand.
These transaction costs include not only direct exchange but also converting, paying, and hedging money.
A common currency makes many of these costs disappear at once.
The savings can then flow back into firms' productivity and innovation.
Costs that once served no purpose are turned into productive investment, helping the whole economy.
When currencies are unified, economies grow more than they would on their own.
So a shared currency provides a strong economic base that benefits everyone.
The gain is collective rather than limited to one company.
choices: 무역의 가장 큰 장벽은 언제나 고객의 부족이다.
환율 변동은 기업의 혁신을 촉진하는 원동력이다.
공통 통화는 거래 비용을 줄여 경제 전체의 성장을 돕는다.
생산성 향상보다 비용 절감이 항상 우선시되어야 한다.
gist.explanation_ko: 공통 통화가 거래 비용을 없애고 절약분이 재투자되어 경제 전체가 성장한다는 것이 요지. ③이 정답.
gist.distractor_ko: ①고객 부족이 늘 최대 장벽은 아니며, ②환율 변동·④대기업 한정·⑤우선순위 주장은 근거가 없다.

passage: Often what blocks trade is not the absence of customers but the cost of reaching markets at competitive prices.
Transaction costs weigh heavily on firms, covering conversion, payment, and hedging as well as direct exchange.
Sharing one currency erases a great many of these costs.
The money no longer spent on conversion can be reinvested into productivity and innovation.
Wasteful costs become productive ones, bringing long-term gains to the entire economy.
Economies that unify their currencies grow more than they could as independents.
In short, a common currency builds a strong foundation that benefits all.
Its rewards extend well beyond any single firm.
choices: The Hidden Danger of Global Trade
Why Small Nations Should Keep Their Money
Hedging: A Risk No Firm Can Avoid
title.explanation_ko: 공통 통화가 비용을 없애 경제 전체에 이익이 된다는 핵심을 '하나의 통화, 공동의 번영'으로 압축한 ①이 제목.
title.distractor_ko: ②위험, ③통화 유지, ④헤징의 불가피성, ⑤시장 쇠퇴는 글의 긍정적 초점과 어긋난다.

choices: money once lost to conversion is now invested to create value
all costs are eventually eliminated from the economy

implication.explanation_ko: '쓸모없던 비용이 생산적 비용으로 바뀐다'는 환전 등에 낭비되던 돈이 가치를 만드는 투자로 전환됨을 뜻한다. ①이 정답.
implication.distractor_ko: ②모든 비용 제거, ③지불 중단, ④통화 가치 상실, ⑤거래 불가능은 본문 의미와 다르다.

passage: Many of the barriers to trade exist not because of a lack of markets, but because there are major obstacles to getting products to market at competitive prices.
Transaction costs are significant for companies, including the cost of converting, paying, and hedging funds.
Having a common currency means that many of those transaction costs disappear.
The savings can be reinvested back into firms' productivity and innovation.
Basically, useless costs turn into productive costs, with longer-term benefits to the whole economy.
By unifying some of the currencies, whole economies benefit and grow more than they would as independents.

grammar.explanation_ko: ⑤ 선행사 The gains를 한정 수식하며 콤마 없이 이어지는 구조가 자연스러우나, 비제한 용법으로 쓰려면 콤마+which가 와야 하고 문맥상 결과를 한정하므로 'that'이 적절하다. 나머지는 모두 어법상 옳다.
grammar.distractor_ko: ①이유의 because of+명사구, ②분사 including, ③복수주어 costs의 동사 disappear, ④주어 costs의 동사 turn은 모두 옳다.

vocab.explanation_ko: ⑤ 통화를 통합하면 독자적으로 있을 때보다 '더(more)' 성장한다는 것이 글의 핵심이므로 'less(덜)'는 문맥에 어긋난다. more가 적절하다.
vocab.distractor_ko: ①장벽 barriers, ②상당한 significant, ③사라지다 disappear, ④생산적인 productive는 모두 문맥에 적절하다.

blocks.A: By unifying some of the currencies, whole economies benefit and grow more than they would as independents, so a common currency provides a strong foundation that all can benefit from.
blocks.B: These transaction costs are significant for companies — not only the straight exchange costs, but also the cost of converting, paying, and hedging funds just to pay for goods and services.
blocks.C: Having a common currency means that many of those transaction costs disappear, and the savings can be reinvested back into firms' productivity and innovation.

order.explanation_ko: 주어진 글의 '경쟁력 있는 가격으로 시장에 도달하는 비용'을 (B)가 거래 비용으로 구체화, (C)가 공통 통화로 그 비용이 사라진다고 전개, (A)가 결론으로 마무리. (B)-(C)-(A).
order.distractor_ko: (C)의 '그 거래 비용(those transaction costs)'은 (B)에서 먼저 비용을 언급해야 가리킬 수 있으므로 (C)가 (B)보다 앞설 수 없다.

summary.summary_template: By adopting a common currency, nations can __(A)__ costly transaction expenses and redirect the savings into __(B)__, so entire economies grow together.
summary.explanation_ko: 공통 통화는 거래 비용을 (A)없애고(eliminate) 그 절약분을 (B)혁신(innovation)에 재투자하게 한다. ②.
summary.distractor_ko: (A)는 increase/preserve가 아니라 eliminate, (B)는 speculation/isolation/competition이 아니라 innovation이어야 한다.
